note: Mcm2-ChEC (Foss et al. 2021), the pombe arm of GSE150800. The archive deposits per-base read-depth tables, so these were binned to 25 bp and each divided by its own genome-wide mean depth - the libraries differ up to 15-fold in depth, and the HU-against-G1 overlays are only readable on a common scale. Containers are the comparisons the paper makes: condition, fragment size range, replicate, and the free-MNase control that the signal must be read against. Generated by pipelines/mcm2chec-foss2021/convert.py. viewLimits are capped at 10 on purpose: ChEC peaks reach 300 times mean coverage, so a scale that fits the tallest peak flattens everything else. The validator's clipping warning for these tracks is expected.
